name: The White-Haired Girl
source:
A mysterious girl who sometimes appears to help the [url=/c71526]protagonist[/url] and then disappears immediately after.

[spoiler]Her real name is Kotoyose Fumino (read as 琴寄 文乃).[/spoiler]
